tools.name: biteship_list_couriers
tools.description: List the courier services Biteship can book, with courier_code, courier_service_code, service type and cash-on-delivery and proof-of-delivery support. Good first call. Biteship API: GET /v1/couriers.

tools.name: biteship_search_areas
tools.description: Find Biteship area ids by place name, for example 'Pesanggrahan' or 'Jakarta Selatan'. Use the id in biteship_get_rates and biteship_create_order. Each call counts against the Maps quota on live keys. Biteship API: GET /v1/maps/areas.

tools.name: biteship_get_rates
tools.description: Quote the price and delivery time of each courier service for one route. Returns quotes only; no order is created. Each quote has company and type values; biteship_create_order takes them as courier_company and courier_type. Each call counts against the Rates quota on live keys. Biteship API: POST /

tools.name: biteship_get_location
tools.description: Read one saved location (an address in the customer's Biteship address book) by its id. Biteship API: GET /v1/locations/{id}.

tools.name: biteship_get_order
tools.description: Read one order by its id: status, courier, waybill_id, tracking_id and status history. Biteship API: GET /v1/orders/{id}.

tools.name: biteship_get_tracking
tools.description: Read the tracking status and history of a shipment by its tracking id (courier.tracking_id on the order). Biteship API: GET /v1/trackings/{id}.

tools.name: biteship_create_order
tools.description: BOOKS A LIVE SHIPMENT: creates a Biteship order and asks the courier to pick up the parcel. It uses the customer's monthly Orders quota or Biteship balance. tools.name: biteship_cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel a live Biteship order by its id. Use only when the user asks to cancel that order. Reason codes in the docs: change_courier, pickup_delay, change_address, others. Biteship API: POST /v1/orders/{id}/cancel.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: biteship_get_rates, biteship_create_order · Public sink: biteship_get_rates, biteship_create_order, biteship_cancel_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: biteship_get_rates, biteship_create_order · Public sink: biteship_get_rates, biteship_create_order, biteship_cancel_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
